# llms.txt — Evonne Flora Co. Artificial Flowers
# Machine-readable overview for AI search engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, etc.)
# Site: https://yvonnehome-06.github.io/

## Brand
Evonne Flora Co. is a China-based floral studio and supplier of artificial flowers and greenery, serving wedding planners, event decorators, holiday decorators and floral wholesalers worldwide. Product range: artificial roses, hydrangeas, peonies, lilies, orchids, chrysanthemums, baby's breath, artificial greenery and leaves, and other artificial blooms. Catalog: 1,000+ SKUs across 11 categories, plus a separate line of ceremony accents (ribbons, drapery, decorative accents). Business model: wholesale supply, custom colour / stem length / bundling and private-label packaging.

## What we do
- Supply realistic artificial flowers, floral stems and greenery for weddings, events and holiday displays.
- Hold colour along the whole production line, so the same shade comes out of every batch.
- Shape every petal and leaf to follow the real plant, and inspect each stem by hand before bundling.
- Test materials, dyes and components so nothing harmful reaches the venue.
- Send video and photos of the actual batch before every shipment for the buyer's confirmation.
- Pack every shipment to protect heads and stems from bending and damage during international transit.
- Prepare export documents (commercial invoice, packing list) for destination markets and support private-label packaging.
